core_findings: Owings Mills is a Census-designated place rather than an incorporated municipality. The U.S. Census Bureau identifies it as Owings Mills CDP, Maryland, and Baltimore County's own Council says there are no incorporated towns, villages, municipalities, or other political subdivisions anywhere in Baltimore County.
Maryland's official local-government reference independently says Baltimore County has no municipalities. That removes the legal basis for any standalone Owings Mills municipal government row.

Official Baltimore County police materials point to county policing rather than a local Owings Mills police department. Baltimore County Police maintains Precinct 3 - Franklin, and an official 2024 police news release for an incident at Rosewood Lane and Reisterstown Road in Owings Mills says Baltimore County Police Department Franklin Precinct officers handled the call.

Repo-side evidence is consistent with an invalid target plus alias contamination, not a real annual jurisdiction. The crosswalk routes MD0035M00 exclusively to Owings Mills, but agency master labels that row rosewood, shows SRS-only presence across 2018-2024 with no NIBRS presence, and shows a 2024 SRS total of zero. Agency-year observations are zero-month summary-annual rows across all seven offenses, and the review queue shows zero reported support with 5,132.273296 total fill.

Official Maryland records strongly suggest rosewood is legacy place/institution contamination rather than a live municipal police surface. Maryland Manual identifies Rosewood Center at Rosewood Lane, Owings Mills, and says the state facility closed on July 1, 2009. That matches both the raw agency name and the Owings Mills location used in the 2024 Baltimore County police incident release.
